title: Per-CELL census of six fresh BUTTON heads whose basket-TRAIN screen prediction is NOT L14: does the screen's cell prediction transfer across codewords, on heads where a band-edge bias cannot fake the answer?
design_ref: S-317 (PR-016's CANNOT ANSWER and why); S-319 (the withdrawal of the structural block, and the six-head inventory); S-320 (exact S-311 bars; head 19 excluded as a known draw); S-312 (the robustness co-primaries); S-310 (the 9-cell/KO collision); S-311 (the bar as a rule)
statistical_unit: DOMAIN for every E (23 domains, 230 rows, never the row). THE TEST UNIT IS THE HEAD.
endpoint: y_install; concept-free semantic_one_word; cell C; n_examples 4

arms.BF_KO: --intervene with NO selector = all 32 heads x 9 band layers; the denominator
arms.HD_<h>: --knockout-cells for ALL NINE band cells of head h. Supplies that head's bar (S-311 rule) and its ADMISSION, and re-measures the whole-head effect PR-CSI-013 already recorded -- see VOID condition 8. EXCLUDED from the depth map and from every per-cell count.

CANDIDATE_PROVENANCE.nominated_on: the basket TRAIN screen (layer) and PR-CSI-013's button whole-head magnitude (admission eligibility). NEITHER uses any button CELL data.
CANDIDATE_PROVENANCE.why_these_six: live on button (|E|/bar >= 1.5 on the EXACT S-311 bars, ci95 excluding 0) AND a screen prediction that is NOT L14

EXCLUDED_already_cell_mapped.why: PR-CSI-016 measured their button cells. Head 19's argmax is KNOWN to be L14 and to match. Counting a known success as a fresh draw is selection on data already read (S-320).

CANDIDATE_PROVENANCE.EXCLUDED_head_16: live and fresh, but predicts L14 -- the layer the spanning rule exists to guard against, and PR-CSI-016 measured that an L14 prediction can match for reasons unrelated to the screen. Its inclusion would move the permutation floor 0.00556 -> 0.00079; both clear alpha, so the floor is not the binding constraint and keeping every prediction out of the adversary's layer is worth more.
CANDIDATE_PROVENANCE.⚠ NOT_HELD_OUT: the screen is TRAIN and basket, so the LAYER is held out on split AND codeword. The HEAD SET is chosen using PR-CSI-013's button validation magnitudes -- the same 23 domains this family reads. That is admission eligibility, not the tested quantity, but it is NOT held out and must not be described as such.

SCREEN_PREDICTIONS_ON_RECORD_BEFORE_THIS.RE_DERIVED_BY_THIS_SCRIPT: yes -- argmax_L |AtP_by_cell[L,h]| over the 288-cell grid; a drift to L14 on any head is a REFUSAL

PRIMARY.statistic: M = number of ADMITTED heads whose argmax band layer by |E| equals that head's frozen screen-predicted layer
PRIMARY.null: the screen's per-cell prediction is unrelated to the button depth profile
PRIMARY.conditional: the same over ADMITTED heads whose predicted layer is unique among the admitted set

permutation.space: distinct assignments of the prediction MULTISET to the admitted heads
permutation.WHY_IT_IS_THE_LOAD_BEARING_ONE: a shared band-edge bias cannot fake it, because a bias says nothing about WHICH head gets which layer. PR-CSI-016 died precisely here.

PRIMARY.SUCCESS: the WEAKEST of the three p-values <= 0.05 AND the spanning rule satisfied

⚠ GATING_DIFFERS_FROM_PR_CSI_016_AND_THA.PR-CSI-016: binomial_only -- its prereg says the co-primaries 'do NOT gate the preregistered PASS/FAIL ... They BOUND THE WORDING', because at K_unique=0 requiring them would have failed that family for a STRUCTURAL reason rather than an empirical one.
⚠ GATING_DIFFERS_FROM_PR_CSI_016_AND_THA.PR-CSI-018: weakest_of_three. THIS FAMILY WAS BUILT SO THAT THE PERMUTATION TEST IS ANSWERABLE: six heads over four distinct layers, 180 assignments, K_unique = 2. The structural excuse does not apply, so the test that a shared band-edge bias cannot fake is allowed to GATE, not merely to annotate.
⚠ GATING_DIFFERS_FROM_PR_CSI_016_AND_THA.WHY_IT_IS_DECLARED_AS_A_FIELD: R29 found the reader silently applying PR-016's rule to this prereg and printing PASS at a weakest p of 0.21 and 0.33. A criterion that lives in prose in one document and in code written for another is TWO criteria (S-302).

PRIMARY.SPANNING_RULE: the MATCHING heads must not all share one band layer, or CANNOT ANSWER whatever the p-values say
PRIMARY.HOW_THE_CLAIM_MUST_BE_STATED: with the WEAKEST of the three, each named. Quoting the binomial alone is FORBIDDEN.

⛔ NO_POST_HOC_SHARPNESS_SUBSETTING.the_temptation: the six screen predictions differ wildly in how DECISIVE they are. Margins over the runner-up: head 6 5.96x, 24 4.70x, 27 1.58x, 11 1.51x, 29 1.26x, 20 1.07x. Head 20's is effectively a coin flip between L11 and its runner-up, and S-307 recorded that a near-tie which happens to land right is far weaker corroboration than a decisive peak.
⛔ NO_POST_HOC_SHARPNESS_SUBSETTING.why_there_is_NO_gate: every sharpness gate changes whether this family can certify AT ALL, which makes the threshold a free parameter tuned by its effect on the floor: margin>=1.25 leaves 5 heads and a floor of 0.0167; margin>=1.5 leaves 4 and a floor of 0.0833, which CANNOT clear alpha; margin>=2.0 leaves 2 and 0.5. Choosing among those by looking at the floor is exactly the selection this sprint forbids, so NO sharpness gate is applied and all six heads are admitted on magnitude alone.
⛔ NO_POST_HOC_SHARPNESS_SUBSETTING.why_that_is_SOUND_and_not_merely_conveni: a flat screen prediction is a near-random one, which is precisely what the PERMUTATION null models. Flat predictions therefore cost POWER, not VALIDITY -- they make a true effect harder to detect and cannot manufacture a false one.
⛔ NO_POST_HOC_SHARPNESS_SUBSETTING.FORBIDDEN_AFTER_THE_READ: reporting any margin-restricted subset of the heads as the result, or as a rescue of a null, or as a qualification of a positive. The margins are frozen HERE, per head, precisely so that a post-hoc subset can be recognised as one. If a sharpness analysis is wanted it is a NEW preregistration on NEW heads.

ADMISSION.rule: head h is ADMITTED iff its whole-head arm HD_<h> has a ci95 excluding 0 AND |E(HD_<h>)| >= 1.5 x bar(h)
ADMISSION.COMPUTED_FROM: the whole-head arm ALONE, never from the cells
ADMISSION.A_DROPPED_HEAD_IS_NOT_A_MISS: it leaves K and is reported with its measured power
ADMISSION.EXPECTED: all six are expected to be admitted -- S-320 measured their EXACT S-311 |E|/bar at 2.86 / 2.85 / 2.49 / 2.42 / 1.84 / 1.54 on PR-CSI-013's arms. A head that fails here when PR-013 says it should not is itself a finding.

DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED_PER_HEAD.method: S-311: the bar is a RULE, computed from this family's own whole-head arm

BAR_IS_A_RULE.rule: bar(h) = z * SD(per-domain paired delta of HD_<h> minus the base arm, ddof=1) / sqrt(n_domains)
BAR_IS_A_RULE.DDOF_IS_PINNED: S-318 verified ddof=1 reproduces PR-CSI-016's published bars exactly and ddof=0 does not
BAR_IS_A_RULE.WHY_NOT_A_NUMBER: a bar must come from the family it judges. PR-CSI-013's values are frozen as VOID condition 8 instead.

DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED_PER_HEAD.⚠ NOT_HELD_OUT: each bar comes from this family's own whole-head arm on the same 23 domains the cells are read on. A DIFFERENT ARM, and only its SPREAD is used -- not circular in the strong sense, but NOT held out.
DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED_PER_HEAD.NOT_THE_PRIMARY: the primary is the argmax agreement, which needs no bar. The bars serve ADMISSION and the descriptive depth map only.

DOSE_EXPECTATION.STATUS: MEASURED (S-299 on nine cells, S-306 on 27 more, S-317 on 27 more)
DOSE_EXPECTATION.⚠ BLIND_AS_AN_IDENTITY: all 54 cell arms expect 224 and all six HD_ arms expect 2016, the SAME dose as BF_KO. Identity comes from each arm's own knockout_cells ONLY (S-310).

population.test_note: TEST is NEVER touched. S-314: it is ALSO already spent and selection-contaminated, so it is not an axis even in principle.
population.SAME_DOMAINS_AS_BASKET: S-256; this controls the CODEWORD, not the domains

NO_RANK_TEST: There is no candidate cell, no control family of arbitrary cells and no rank. The PRIMARY is a per-head ARGMAX agreement against a prediction frozen on a different split AND codeword. control_prefix and n_controls are DELIBERATELY ABSENT so the rank tooling refuses this prereg.
CENSUS_DELIVERABLE: 54 single-cell effects E(BF_H<h>_L<ll>) = mean over domains of (y_install(cell) - y_install(BF_BASE)), each with a bootstrap ci95; six whole-head HD_<h> arms supplying the bars and ADMISSION, EXCLUDED from every per-cell count; and the BF_KO denominator.
SELECTION_RE_ENTERS_WHEN: any single cell is named as 'the' site. The PRIMARY tests a PREDICTION made before the data existed, which is why it carries a p; naming a winner afterwards is selection on the data that produced it.
DOSE_IDENTITY_IS_BLIND_HERE: 54 cell arms share 224 and seven arms share 2016 (six HD_ plus BF_KO). Identity comes from knockout_cells ONLY (S-292/S-310).
WHAT_THIS_CANNOT_ANSWER: whether any cell is PRIVILEGED among ARBITRARY cells -- there is no control family of arbitrary cells anywhere in this sprint
anything about the SOURCE of the effect -- S-316 blocked that family pending a mass measurement that has not been made
whether the screen predicts for heads that are NULL on button; this family admits only live ones, by design
anything about the other 26 heads, DOMAIN generality, or TEST
anything behavioural: y_install is a semantic readout, not a refusal endpoint
VOID_CONDITIONS: 3. any TEST domain in any arm
5. an arm whose recorded knockout_cells != this prereg's cell_sets entry for it
6. score_behavior.py or src/ edited while these arms are in flight
7. any single-cell arm recording a dose other than 224, or any HD_ arm other than 2016

8. ⚠ PROVENANCE: any HD_<h> arm whose E differs from PR-CSI-013's measurement of the SAME head, codeword and split by more than 1e-6. S-318 demonstrated bit-identical reproduction across two jobs and two NODES, so a difference means the population, bank, exclusions or model revision has drifted and nothing here is readable.
10. the read amended after any number is seen
MUST_NOT_BE_SAID_IF_POSITIVE: the binomial p alone -- the claim is stated with the WEAKEST of the three (S-312)
that cell (L,h) is 'the writer' -- this tests the SCREEN's prediction, not a cell's privilege among arbitrary cells
that the screen is a validated cell selector IN GENERAL -- at most this adds six heads on a second codeword, all chosen because they were live there
anything about heads that are NULL on button, which this family excludes by construction
MUST_NOT_BE_SAID_IF_NULL: that the basket result is withdrawn -- S-306/S-307 stand on their own data; this is about TRANSFER
that PR-CSI-016 is explained -- it returned CANNOT ANSWER and still does
'underpowered' without quoting K, the dropped heads and their MEASURED power
